title: >>> JULIE COVINGTON
lyrics_synced:
[01:02.31] It won't be easy, you'll think it's strange
[01:10.75] When I try to explain how I feel
[01:17.87] That I still need your love after all that I've done
[01:27.31] You won't believe me
[01:33.13] All you will see is a girl you once knew
[01:39.89] Although she's dressed up to the nines
[01:46.57] At sixes and sevens with you
[01:56.01] I had to let it happen, I had to change
[02:04.51] Couldn't stay all my life down at heel
[02:11.68] Looking out of the window staying out of the sun
[02:21.04] So I chose freedom
[02:26.90] Running around trying everything new
[02:33.58] But nothing impressed me at all
[02:40.75] I never expected it to
[02:48.19] Don't cry for me Argentina
[02:54.53] The truth is I never left you
[03:00.41] All through my wild life
[03:03.79] My mad existence
[03:07.14] I kept my promise
[03:10.52] Don't keep your distance
[03:19.31] And as for fortune and as for fame
[03:26.97] I never invited them in
[03:32.67] Though it seemed to the world they were all I desired
[03:40.64] They are illusions
[03:45.58] They're not the solutions they promised to be
[03:51.27] The answer was here all the time
[03:57.30] I love you and hope you love me
[04:05.28] Don't cry for me Argentina
[04:11.92] The truth is I never left you
[04:18.22] All through my wild life
[04:21.77] My mad existence
[04:25.46] I kept my promise
[04:29.19] Don't keep your distance
[04:34.22] Don't cry for me Argentina
[04:40.80] The truth is I never left you
[04:46.68] All through my wild life
[04:50.06] My mad existence
[04:53.57] I kept my promise
[04:57.15] Don't keep your distance
[05:02.15] Have I said to much?
[05:05.25] There's nothing more I can think of to say to you
